Title: Password reset after lockout
Root Cause: Repeated cached password on mobile device
Resolution: Reset password, cleared stale mobile credential, verified sign-in and MFA

Title: Outlook stuck in disconnected mode
Resolution: Created new Outlook profile, re-added mailbox, confirmed send/receive

Title: VPN fails with authentication error
Root Cause: Expired cached password in VPN client
Resolution: Updated stored credential, reauthenticated MFA, verified access to internal share

Title: Printer shows offline
Root Cause: Stale TCP/IP port after printer DHCP change
Resolution: Updated port to reserved IP, restarted spooler, printed test page

Title: New hire account and laptop setup
Resolution: Created account, assigned groups and licenses, configured laptop, completed checklist

Title: Employee offboarding
Resolution: Disabled account, revoked sessions, converted mailbox, transferred files, recovered device

Title: MFA registration loop
Resolution: Cleared authentication methods and completed fresh registration

Title: OneDrive files not syncing
Resolution: Renamed file, resumed sync, reset client, verified cloud status

Title: Laptop disk space critically low
Root Cause: Large temporary update cache and downloads
Resolution: Removed temporary files, archived downloads, enabled Storage Sense

Title: Teams microphone not detected
Resolution: Enabled microphone access, selected correct device, completed test call

Title: Shared mailbox access request
Resolution: Added user to mailbox permission group and verified automapping

Title: BitLocker recovery prompt after firmware update
Root Cause: TPM measurement changed after BIOS update
Resolution: Verified device ownership, used escrowed recovery key, suspended and resumed protection

Title: Cannot reach internal website
Root Cause: Incorrect DNS server from static adapter settings
Resolution: Restored DHCP DNS, flushed cache, verified name resolution

Title: Adobe Reader installation request
Resolution: Installed managed package, applied updates, verified PDF opening

Title: Windows update repeatedly fails
Resolution: Reset update components, repaired image, installed updates successfully

Title: Account disabled unexpectedly
Root Cause: Account expiration date set during temporary assignment
Resolution: Confirmed employment, removed expiration, enabled account, documented approval

Title: Mapped drive missing
Root Cause: User removed from department access group
Resolution: Validated approval, restored group membership, refreshed policy

Title: Wi-Fi disconnects in conference room
Resolution: Changed channel plan, rebooted AP, monitored stable connections

Title: Excel add-in crashes at launch
Resolution: Disabled old add-in, installed supported version, verified workbook workflow

Title: Monitor not detected through dock
Resolution: Updated dock firmware and display driver, power-cycled dock, verified dual monitors

Title: Phishing email reported
Resolution: Isolated message, blocked sender/domain, searched tenant, reset exposed password, educated user

Title: Slow startup and high CPU
Resolution: Disabled nonessential startup apps, removed adware, verified performance

Title: New project folder access
Resolution: Added user to project security group and verified read/write permissions

Title: Cannot send email to external recipient
Root Cause: Recipient autocomplete entry contained obsolete address
Resolution: Removed cached entry, used current address, verified delivery

Title: Laptop camera unavailable
Root Cause: Camera disabled by physical privacy switch
Resolution: Enabled switch, updated driver, verified Teams video

Title: Remote desktop connection denied
Root Cause: User missing Remote Desktop Users membership
Resolution: Confirmed authorization, added group membership, verified connection

Title: Browser redirects to unwanted search page
Resolution: Disconnected network, removed extension, scanned device, reset browser, changed credentials

Title: VoIP headset has no audio
Root Cause: Default output switched after Windows update
Resolution: Set headset as default communications device and verified call

Title: Software license activation failed
Resolution: Reclaimed unused seat, assigned license, verified activation

Title: Quarterly access review request
Resolution: Exported group membership, validated owners, removed obsolete access, archived report
